entities.name: Query DapH protein
observations: 236 aa bacterial protein; calculated molecular weight 24,835 Da and theoretical pI 4.89.
Exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt A4ILT5 from Geobacillus thermodenitrificans.
Pfam matches: DapH_N (PF08503) at residues 4–87 and Hexapep/Hexapep_2 regions spanning approximately residues 104–198.

entities.name: A4ILT5
observations: Reviewed UniProt protein from Geobacillus thermodenitrificans; annotated as 2,3,4,5-tetrahydropyridine-2,6-dicarboxylate N-acetyltransferase.
Catalyzes acetyl transfer from acetyl-CoA to tetrahydrodipicolinate.

entities.name: RHEA:13085
observations: Reaction corresponds to tetrahydrodipicolinate N-acetyltransferase activity.

entities.name: L-lysine biosynthesis DAP pathway
observations: The enzyme performs step 1/3 of the acetylase route from (S)-tetrahydrodipicolinate toward LL-2,6-diaminopimelate.
